Wat er aan beveiliging aan of uit staat: Which security measures are on or off on this installation

Which security measures are on or off on this installation, read at the moment you open this page. A problem or point of attention here is usually a setting on the server (.env) or under Settings, Security.
Wat er op deze installatie stil kan fale: What can fail silently on this installation: the scheduler, the queue, migrations left behind after an update, and settings still on test in production. Superadmins also see a problem here as a bar at the top of every screen.
Wat er verwijderd is, staat hier en kan: What has been deleted is listed here and can be restored. Pages, articles, menus, global blocks and redirects are deleted permanently after :dagen days; products, discount codes, forms and popups stay until you delete them here yourself, because orders, submissions and views refer to them.
Wat het CMS doet om de beheeromgeving en: What the CMS does to protect the admin panel and the webshop, and where each measure is configured. What is actually on or off on this installation is shown in the Security check.

If this is off, an admin no longer gets a reset link; a fellow superadmin sets a new password, or dashed:set-password on the server. Every reset request on an admin account triggers a security alert regardless.
